entities.summary: Johann Jakob Trog was a Swiss politician and President of the Swiss National Council (1851/1852). He sat in the National Council as a representative of the Canton of Solothurn. He was affiliated with the Liberal Centre, which later developed into the Liberal Party of Switzerland.
